feeds.title: The Law of Work
feeds.description: The Law of Work Blog was launched in 2008, making this one of the longest-running law blogs in Canada. I created the blog as a teaching aid to allow me to bring real world events into the classroom. The target was students in my various classes on labor and employment law. In the beginning, there were virtually no other blogs in Canada dedicated to work law and policy. Law firms had not yet created their own blogs to summarize important cases they worked on or key developments in the field. The legal blogosphere was new.
